operation: rebuild Financial writing execution architecture after rejected cross-border-ecommerce output
objective: improve evidence-bounded reader value by separating cognition, story construction and publication acceptance without creating a second business owner or state machine

evidence.summary: historical audit declared PASS -> DELIVERY but lacked current text-bound publication-fitness evidence
user rejected the writing outcome and required system-level diagnosis rather than another local prose patch
UAOS 1.6 supports domain-owned internal work graphs with explicit dependencies, structured critique and owner adjudication while keeping one user-facing business owner
agent orchestration is management of multi-step flow, tool use, handoffs, guardrails and context; separation of concerns does not require uncontrolled role multiplication
story form should follow content and writers should know multiple forms rather than force every story into one container
negative cross-border replay is blocked by the new admission model while a held-out ice-snow article fits a different SYSTEM_MAP story geometry

learned_items: PASS labels are not semantic acceptance evidence
research completeness does not guarantee publication representation without an explicit story contract
story forms are candidates selected by material rather than universal templates
one domain owner can use explicit internal orchestration without creating multiple business state machines
assumptions_challenged: more prose rules will automatically improve article quality
a same-session audit can safely self-certify with broad PASS labels
multi-agent role multiplication is inherently better than one owner with explicit passes
one story template can optimize all financial topics

alternatives.mechanism: keep the prior execution topology and add more detailed writing/audit instructions
fit_conditions: failure is isolated to one missing deterministic rule
misfit_conditions: generation and audit share the same weak acceptance topology
multiple defects recur despite existing rules

alternatives.mechanism: create separate research, writer, editor, originality and fact-check agents as independent business actors
failure_modes: risk of second business truth/state plane
fit_conditions: tools, permissions, context, output contracts or independence materially differ
misfit_conditions: same model/tool context can express the separation as explicit owner-controlled passes

alternatives.mechanism: retain one Financial business owner/state machine, add explicit cognition/story/audit contracts, focused internal pass DAG and evidence-backed admission gates
failure_modes: live reader-value benefit still requires post-promotion observation
fit_conditions: one domain owns the full business outcome
separation is primarily cognitive/contextual rather than permission/tool based
misfit_conditions: future evidence shows materially different tools/permissions or independent certification is required

counterexamples: the rule-rich historical cross-border workflow still produced a user-rejected result and an unsupported PASS
held-out ice-snow material uses SYSTEM_MAP rather than cross-border-specific structure, showing a universal story template would be a bad generalization
same-model critic passes cannot become independent merely by assigning different role names
rejected_paths: PATCH_EXISTING_RULEBOOK: rejected because the observed failure is admission/topology-level, not a single missing prose instruction
MULTI_AGENT_PIPELINE: rejected as default because current responsibilities do not yet justify separate business owners or independent-executor claims; retain as conditional future option
selection_rationale: It repairs the demonstrated soft-self-pass failure while preserving Financial ownership and historical compatibility. DecisionEnvelope, StoryBlueprint and PublicationFitness become explicit executable contracts; UAOS 1.6 internal orchestration supplies the common method for dependency/critique/adjudication without forcing a second state machine. Story geometry remains material-specific rather than template-fixed.

new_counterexamples: existing rules did not prevent rejection
